sentence: This project studies how polygenic risk scores for Alzheimer's Disease work in European, African and Native American groups.
This project builds a way to make antibodies that work better in nonhuman primate studies, using machine learning and yeast surface display.
This project studies how two metabolites from bacteria help health and how a lipid-mediated nutrient-sensing system guides animal development in mammals.
This project builds a way to find patients with antiphospholipid syndrome in large electronic health record groups and sort them by risk of poor outcomes.
This project offers animal model services, using mice, rats, zebrafish, and killifish, to help vision scientists study eye disease.
This project studies whether improving inflammation resolution can be used as a therapy for treating bone marrow failure.
This project tries to measure low-value cardiovascular care accurately and to find out whether a program to reduce it works.
This project builds a risk model that combines genomic information with lifestyle and traditional risk factors to predict heart attack in people of diverse ancestries.
This project builds models that predict lung cancer risk for former smokers, to find those at high risk for screening and intervention.
This project studies how seizures and other neuronal activity affect glioma cells and how glioma and neurons signal to each other.
This project studies how nitrogenase proteins carry out nitrogen fixation inside living bacteria, using mass spectrometry and cryoelectron tomography.
This project works to reduce cancer burden and improve cancer outcomes through research and collaboration.
This project studies how mutations linked to Alzheimer's disease change the way microglia work, using a mouse brain with human microglia.
This project uses imaging and machine learning to study how the mu and kappa opioid receptor systems relate to behavior in patients with Alcohol Use Disorder.
This project studies how lipid accumulation is controlled and how it affects signaling in the stem cell niche.
This project builds a prediction model for the risk of bleeding in patients with cancer who take blood thinners.
This project tries to build a biomarker and a genetic test that show which men face a higher risk of aggressive prostate cancer.
This project studies how recurrent hypoglycemia affects brain blood vessels and cognitive behavior in diabetic rats, using an imaging technique.
This project studies how a regulatory RNA controls virulence factors in Staphylococcus aureus, a pathogen that causes human infectious disease.
This project builds an AI system that uses sensing and machine learning to detect early warning signals of exacerbations in Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease.
